instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Gather what my account's setup is made of and draw the Get started screen from it", and give it account_id (The page's own account).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-setup and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: The one read of the Get started screen (tool:get-started).

4. It is given only these rows of the person's, read by the AI from the person's own store and handed in as stored.workspace { label: value }: the setting show-rules and the setting setup-context. A setting left out is unknown, never none; the run reaches no store and keeps nothing.
